notes.title: Loyalty discount back up again!
notes.notes: Steam-owners of the base game Armada 2526 can now get Armada 2526 Gold against a very nice loyalty discount. The offer runs until July 1st 2013. Owners of Armada 2526 must login to Steam and check the Armada 2526 Gold store page for details. If you make this purchase it adds the Supernova expansion to your base game, effectively upgrading it to Armada 2526 Gold.

notes.title: Now Available - Armada 2526 Gold
notes.notes:
Armada 2526 Gold is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off.

Lead one of 18 different alien races to become a mighty pan-galactic empire. Manage your colonies, deploy your fleets and conduct research. Plot your strategy and turn your planets into mighty bastions. Explore new star systems, where you may encounter tachyon storms, psychic plants, primitives or find abandoned alien technology. Diplomacy is of utter importance in being successful. Make pacts and alliances, make threats or ask for favours - and when the time is right, replace diplomacy by space combat and fight it out in real-time 3D.

*Offer ends March 7th at 10AM Pacific Time.

There is also a special loyalty discount for owners of Armada 2526. Please login to Steam and check the store page for details.
